name: Lake Everstill
summary: Murlocs and lake beasts now make Lake Everstill dangerous beside Lakeshire. Once known for calm fishing and clear mountain runoff, its waters and shores have grown perilous.

sections.title: Heart of the Valley
sections.body: Lake Everstill fills Redridge's central basin beside Lakeshire. Its clear waters run east toward Stonewatch, and a bridge crosses the lake at the heart of town. The lake has long supported local trade and drawn anglers seeking quiet. Now, wilderness threats have broken that calm along the shore.

sections.title: Trouble in the Depths
sections.body: Hostile murlocs have made camps along the northern and eastern shallows, disrupting trade and harrying fishermen. Dangerous threshers patrol the deeper waters below.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures live in Lake Everstill?
faq.answer: Hostile murloc tribes crowd the shallows, including scouts, tidecallers, and flesheaters. Giant threshers and aggressive muckdwellers patrol beneath the surface.

faq.q: Where does the water from Lake Everstill flow?
faq.answer: An eastern river carries Lake Everstill's water past the slopes below Stonewatch, a stronghold held by Blackrock.

faq.q: Can you fish safely in Lake Everstill?
aliases: is it safe to fish lakeshire
faq.answer: Catfish and sagefish fill the lake, but fishing has become dangerous. Murloc raiding parties camp along the water's edge, and large threshers attack anyone who ventures too far into the deep.

angles.text: As a mage passing through Lakeshire, you will find the lake's dangers mundane rather than arcane. Murloc camps crowd the shallows, while threshers patrol deeper waters.
As an Alliance member, you know that control of the lake and its crossings is vital to Lakeshire's survival against coordinated incursions by Redridge murlocs and nearby Blackrock orcs.
